rolesCard.stepUpNote: Changing roles needs the confirmation code sent to your email.
rolesCard.emptyBody: The user will have no permissions and cannot work in the admin.

confirm.Suspension: The account is signed out and cannot sign in until the day you picked.
confirm.Ban: The account is signed out and cannot sign in until someone lifts the ban.
confirm.reinstate: The account can sign in again, and the reason is kept in the activity log.

roleEditor.name: Name
roleEditor.stepUpNote: Saving needs the confirmation code sent to your email.

permissions.systemWarning: This role gets system permissions (users, backups, data reset...). Make sure that is what you want.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Anything deleted lands here first. Deleting forever needs its own permission.
trash.purgeBody: "{label}" will be deleted for good and cannot be restored. We will ask for a code sent to your email.

backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: A full copy with the data, images and settings. Run one now and check it is sound.
backups.downloadBody: The backup holds all the store's data. We will ask for a code sent to your email.

export.title: Export data
export.hint: Leave the dates empty to export the last 30 days.
export.badRange: The start date is after the end date.
export.stepUpNote: Exporting customers needs a code sent to your email.
export.audited: Every export is recorded in the audit log.

reset.title: Reset data
reset.hint: Deletes the data you pick for good. A backup is taken automatically first.

business.title: Business
business.body: Orders, sales, stock, expenses and accounts.

reset.customersNeedBusiness: Deleting customers also deletes the business data, because orders and warranties point to them.
reset.stepUpNote: Owner only, and needs a code sent to their email.
reset.confirmBody: The data you picked will be deleted for good. A backup is taken first, then we will ask for a code sent to your email.
reset.result: {rows} rows deleted. The backup taken before it:
